SysDataModelXML.SQLScript:
--获取填报车间的合集 WITH CTE_DEPT AS (SELECT ITMNO ,PRQNUM ,String_agg(DEPT, '/') AS PRADEPT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT L.PRQNUM ,L.ITMNO ,H.DEPT FROM PREQAL L INNER JOIN PREQAH H ON L.DOCNUM = H.DOCNUM WHERE ISNULL(L.PRQNUM,'')<>'' ) DP GROUP BY ITMNO,PRQNUM)
SELECT '' GXFLG ,ITMCT.ITMCTDES + '(' + ITM.TCLCOD + ')' TCLCOD ,ITMCT.ITMCTDES ,ITM.ITMNO ,ITM.ITMNAM ,REPLACE(ITM.ITMNAM1, '''', ' ') ITMNAM1 ,REPLACE(ITM.ITMNAM2, '''', ' ') ITMNAM2 ,REPLACE(ITM.ITMSPEC, '''', ' ') ITMSPEC ,REPLACE(ITM.ITMSIZE, '''', ' ') ITMSIZE ,L.FAC ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), H.DOCDAT, 21) DOCDAT ,L.BPSNO ,ISNULL(BPS.BPSNAM,L.BPSNO) BPSNAM ,dbo.OPTDES('TSICOD1', ITM.TSICOD1) TSICOD1 ,dbo.OPTDES('TSICOD2', ITM.TSICOD2) TSICOD2 ,dbo.OPTDES('TSICOD3', ITM.TSICOD3) TSICOD3 ,dbo.OPTDES('TSICOD4', ITM.TSICOD4) TSICOD4 ,L.ITMVER ,H.SITE ,H.DEPT ,D.DEPTNAM DEPTDES ,T.PRADEPT ,ITM.IVATTYP ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), L.REQDAT, 23) REQDAT ,L.STU ,L.UOM ,L.UOMCOE ,L.QTY ,L.QTYSTU ,H.DOCTYP SRCTYP ,L.DOCNUM SRCDOC ,L.DOCLIN SRCLIN ,H.REMARK+L.REMARK REMARK ,'{6}' DOCNUM ,LSP.BPSNAM + ' : ' + Format(LSP.GROPRI, '0.######') + ' ' + LSP.CUR LATEST ,Isnull(L.PRQLOC, '') PRQLOC ,ISNULL(USR.NAME,L.PFBUSR) PFBUSR ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(16), L.PFBTIM, 21) PFBTIM ,CASE WHEN Datediff(DAY, L.PFBTIM, Getdate()) <= 7 THEN NULL ELSE '1' END AS TimeCheck ,Datediff(DAY, PFBTIM, Getdate()) TJDAYS FROM PREQUL L INNER JOIN ITM ON ITM.ITMNO = L.ITMNO --产品 LEFT JOIN ITMCT ON ITMCT.TCLCOD = ITM.TCLCOD LEFT JOIN PREQUH H ON H.DOCNUM = L.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN [ENTDEPT] D ON H.[DEPT] = D.DEPT LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS ON L.BPSNO = BPS.BPSNO LEFT JOIN LINK.DBO.SysUser USR ON USR.LoginUser = L.PFBUSR LEFT JOIN(SELECT TOP 1 L.ITMNO ,H.BPSNO ,H.CUR ,BPS2.BPSNAM ,GROPRI FROM PORDLIN L LEFT JOIN PORDER H ON H.DOCNUM = L.DOCNUM LEFT JOIN BPSUP BPS2 ON H.BPSNO = BPS2.BPSNO WHERE L.DOCSTA = 2 ORDER BY L.CRETIM DESC) LSP ON LSP.ITMNO = L.ITMNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT SRCDOC --过滤掉直接生成采购订单的产品 ,SRCLIN ,Sum(QTY) PORQTY ,Sum(QTYSTU) PORQTYSTU FROM PORDLIN WHERE (DOCSTA<>4 OR (DOCSTA=4 AND QTY<=PRCQTY)) --20251010 Dina 增加收货自动关闭逻辑 AND SRCTYP = 'PRQ' GROUP BY SRCDOC ,SRCLIN)P ON P.SRCDOC = L.DOCNUM AND P.SRCLIN = L.DOCLIN LEFT JOIN CTE_DEPT T ON T.PRQNUM=L.DOCNUM AND T.ITMNO=L.ITMNO LEFT JOIN(SELECT PRICD1 ITMNO FROM PRILIST PLIST WHERE ( CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), Getdate(), 21) BETWEEN PLIST.STRDAT AND PLIST.ENDDAT ) GROUP BY PRICD1) ST ON ST.ITMNO = L.ITMNO WHERE L.DOCSTA = 2 AND Isnull(L.PCKFLG, 0) = 0 --没有被驳回的 AND Isnull(L.PINNUM, '') = '' AND Isnull(P.SRCDOC, '') = '' --过滤掉直接生成采购订单的产品 AND ISNULL(ST.ITMNO, '') = '' --20251010 Dina增加过滤有效协约价的记录 AND H.SITE = '{0}' AND H.DEPT LIKE '%{1}%' AND ITM.TCLCOD LIKE N'%{2}%' --产品种类 AND L.ITMNO LIKE '%{3}%' AND Isnull(L.ITMVER, '') LIKE '%{4}%' --部分产品没有品名，需要ISNULL处理 AND ITM.ITMNAM + ITM.ITMNAM1 + ITM.ITMNAM2 + ITM.ITMSPEC + ITM.ITMSIZE LIKE N'%{5}%' AND (ISNULL(L.PRQLOC,'')= '{8}' OR '{8}'='') ORDER BY Datediff(DAY, PFBTIM, Getdate()) DESC ,L.ITMNO ,L.ITMVER ,H.DEPT
SysDataModelXML.SQLNew: --处理驳回 UPDATE PREQUL SET PCKFLG = 1 ,PCKUSR = N'#LOGIN_USER#' ,PCKTIM = Getdate() ,PCKCOMMENT = N'#PCKCOMMENT#' WHERE DOCNUM = '#SRCDOC#' AND DOCLIN = 0#SRCLIN# AND '#GXFLG#' = '1';
SysDataModelXML.SQLClear: --宁波采购 UPDATE PREQUL SET PRQLOC = N'#PPRQLOC#' WHERE DOCNUM = '#SRCDOC#' AND DOCLIN = 0#SRCLIN# AND '#GXFLG#' = '1';
